pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.4: “etha sikkhamānā imaṃ jānātha, imaṃ detha, imaṃ āharatha, iminā attho, imaṃ kappiyaṃ karothā”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma: bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpessanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.16: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ dātuṃ”
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.18: tāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhunīnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjalimpaggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.19: ahaṃ ayye itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā, sikkhamānā saṅghaṃ vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.24: ayaṃ itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā sikkhamānā saṅghaṃ vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ yācati,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.25: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ dadeyya,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.28: ayaṃ itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā sikkhamānā saṅghaṃ vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ yācati,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.29: saṅgho itthannāmāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ deti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.30: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammutiyā dānaṃ. sā tuṇhassa,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.32: dinnā saṅghena itthannāmāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammuti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.33: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.34: atha kho bhagavā tā bhikkhuniyo anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubharatāya …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.35: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.36.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:2.10: ñatti dutiyena kammena vuṭṭhānasammuti na dinnāhoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:2.13: vuṭṭhāpessāmīti gaṇaṃ vā ācariniṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati sīmaṃ vā sammannati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:2.17: gaṇassa ca ācariniyā ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
